sources.project: CADMPEG exact-tag workspace and CLI manifests
sources.observation: The workspace is version 0.6.2 and contains cadmpeg-codec-sat. The CLI's default feature list includes sat, so the tagged release configuration includes the bare SAT codec.

The release workflow is triggered by version-tag pushes, checks out the event ref, and invokes cargo-dist build with the tag. This binds the release procedure to the tag configuration but is not an independent reproducible build or runtime test.

The bare stream codec is read-only. Its documented verified Spatial ACIS majors are 217 and 218; other majors are unverified. The docs describe losses, unknown records, and unresolved geometry/topology questions. This is a candidate parser/neutral-geometry comparison only, not a DWG/DXF/AcDs reader, owner/key oracle, or native CAD consumer.
The surfaced docs.rs latest page identifies version 0.6.1, separate from the 0.6.2 GitHub source tag/release. Do not silently substitute the package artifact/API for the release binary.

Existing plan evidence records CADMPEG source/notes among cq-acis format references and CadQuery/OCCT geometry construction. Agreement between these routes remains correlated format-discovery evidence and is not an independent kernel result.
